'''2012 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Evan Kirkpatrick DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Evan Kirkpatrick]] at [[2012 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|A Stunning Move|VB7-D-astunningmove-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
